_provenance: Composition pass — trains the seams between all 9 rungs using sleepwalker beat data. The measure function runs a full game loop beat and checks inter-rung dependencies. Research basis: WorldModelData's 200+ properties per frame approach, using our own sleepwalker as the data engine.
name: composition
mirror_wall: The full game loop must close. Player spawns on formed terrain, survives via shelter, explores for resources, helps an NPC, builds beacon components, and the signal reflects their choices.
walls: Player spawns on formed, walkable terrain (rung 2 output)
O2 drains and shelter refills work in the same session (rung 3 + rung 5)
At least one resource type exists in the spawn biome (rung 4 output)
At least one NPC with a need exists near the resource spawn zone (rung 7)
Giving the correct resource to the NPC unlocks a blueprint (rung 7 + rung 8)
The beacon can be activated from unlocked blueprints (rung 8 + rung 9)
Signal strength at beacon activation equals f(NPCs helped) (rung 9)
Full loop completes without crash or softlock in under 5 minutes of play

output.format: Composed game state: spawn point, shelter position, resource layout, NPC positions, beacon position, signal curve
